global_invariants: Choose carrier and content-driven composition before subject origin mode. Resolve exactly one SUBJECT_ASSEMBLY into the composition's object slot, then choose render treatment and scale role.

Resolve all visible objects into one SUBJECT_MASS. A compound set uses one compact silhouette, primary satellites use an explicit primary-subordinate hierarchy, and a repeated family follows one path with one focal instance.
Object footprint and perceptual attention are independent: a monumental object may occupy more canvas area while the title remains the first reading event.
Choose exactly one SUBJECT_ORIGIN_MODE from ABSTRACT_FORM, ARCHIVE_ARTIFACT, or SPECULATIVE_OBJECT unless a supplied-image source override is active.
Choose exactly one focal event and one release zone.

Object families do not select or forbid Composition Contracts. Every object family can enter every contract by adapting crop, scale, orientation, repetition, or fragmentation to the locked object slot while preserving identity anchors.
An ARCHIVE_ARTIFACT or SPECULATIVE_OBJECT must expose 2–4 identity anchors; do not use an abstract blob as a substitute for either.
A SPECULATIVE_OBJECT must have one named hypothetical function and a coherent relationship between its purpose-bearing parts.

A SPECULATIVE_OBJECT must resolve exactly one complete SPECULATIVE_MORPHOLOGY specification. Use a compatible catalog archetype or a content-derived CUSTOM_COMPOSED morphology; catalog archetypes are not a whitelist. Integrate the function into the dominant form and never begin from a present-day product merely to round its corners.

A SPECULATIVE_OBJECT must exaggerate one silhouette proportion or spatial relationship, integrate a function-bearing rounded opening or negative space when appropriate, and keep secondary parts subordinate to the dominant curvature or volume logic.

Warm retro-future material character is required for SPECULATIVE_OBJECT: colored enamel, molded fiberglass, creamy lacquer, translucent resin, bubble glass, warm metal trim, or upholstery. Cold gray-white minimal-product language is forbidden.
An ARCHIVE_ARTIFACT must preserve historical provenance, local material differences, and authentic proportions after crop, grade, and grain.
Designed copy follows the carrier text contract. INTRINSIC_ARTIFACT_TEXT is identity evidence, not poster copy, and must never be replaced with invented legible labels.
Resolve SCREEN_STATE only for object families with explicit screen-state support. Generated screen content is not INTRINSIC_ARTIFACT_TEXT.
SIGNAL uses one nonverbal low-resolution system. CARRIER relocates exactly one locked editorial support element into the screen without duplication or copy-budget expansion.
In a REPEATED_FAMILY, only the primary or largest screen may be active; subordinate screens remain DORMANT.
Do not introduce invented packaging facts, brands, logos, URLs, QR codes, dates, or pseudo-text.
The primary form, title clear zone, and support details must pass the current collision and thumbnail gates.

forbidden_pairs.reason: Full palette assimilation erases historical color and material evidence.
A non-referential form has no original product color or provenance to preserve.
A small intact object needs a baseline, horizon, tangent, contact shadow, or other explicit grounding cue.
A monumental fragment requires decisive crop and architectural use of the object mass.
A repeated field needs one rhythm event; do not add a second unrelated scale event.
Do not combine a full perspective field with a second portal system.
Every support element must be supplied by the user or grounded in the source.
Type-dominant work allows only one subordinate subject interruption, not a competing multi-object ensemble.
The primary object must remain at least twice the perceptual weight of each satellite.
Two or three objects must form one semantically and spatially coherent subject mass.
Concrete spatial objects must not collapse into cosmic cliché.
Directional objects use an axis or tangent, not an orbit system.
Speculative form must start from a retro-future geometric archetype rather than cosmetically smoothing a current product.

forbidden_pairs.right: black glass band or full-width LED strip
forbidden_pairs.reason: Contemporary EV and appliance signals override the intended streamline-era future language.
The canopy or aperture must be a volumetric convex part of the silhouette.
Packaging must not invent specifications, certifications, ingredients, brands, or legal information.
A signal state is nonverbal and cannot contain letters, numbers, code, menus, or pseudo-text.
The validated carrier state relocates one factual support element from an EDITORIAL_POSTER only.
Screen copy counts toward the 5–7 element budget and must be removed from every external location.
Generated screen copy is designed copy, never authentic source-borne artifact text.
Only the compositionally primary instance may use SIGNAL or CARRIER.

PACKAGING_FACE: seam, fold, label boundary, or die-cut implication
RECORD_SLEEVE: one strong image or typographic event
